import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { setTimeout as delay } from 'node:timers/promises';
import { EventEmitter, once } from 'node:events';
// The VM-only condition (PROJECT_SANDBOX_REQUIRED on the VM): VM=true in the probe, false in its control.
const VM = true;

test('starting a unit the service manager does not know is refused', async (t) => {
  await assert.rejects(async () => {
    await start('worklane-no-such-unit.service');
    async function start(unit) {
      const r = spawnSync('systemctl', ['--version'], { encoding: 'utf8' });
      assert.ok(r.pid > 0 || r.error);
      await delay(1);
      assert.fail(`no such unit: ${unit}`);
    }
  }, /no such unit/);
});
